title: Grateful Dead Live at Sports Arena on 1994-04-04
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (WAV 24-bit/48k) > Adobe Audition 2020 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/24
taper: cassettes were made for Vince Welnick by Dick Latvala
source: SBD > DAT Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a magical night with Jerry’s stellar Terrapin Station and a raucous I Fought the Law finale.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that lets listeners soak in a truly magical evening. Jerry Garcia is highlighted as fully engaged, nailing Terrapin Station, while the show closes on an energetic I Fought the Law amid an unforgettable Deadhead riot atmosphere.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review praises both performance and recording; high praise yields a top rating but limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer explicitly calls the quality great; no technical issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Even with a chaotic riot incident, the set maintained momentum and ended on a high‑energy note.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as very engaged and on point, especially during Terrapin Station.
